legal_ref: Value-Added Tax Consolidation Act 2010, s. 46(1)(a) (23% substituted by Finance Act 2012 s. 87 from 1.1.2012); s. 46(1A) (21% from 1 Sep 2020 to 28 Feb 2021, inserted by Financial Provisions (Covid-19) (No. 2) Act 2020 s. 12(b))
quote: 46.—(1) Tax shall be charged ... at whichever of the following rates is appropriate in any particular case: (a) subject to subsection (1A), 23 per cent of the amount on which tax is chargeable ... (1A) During the period from 1 September 2020 to 28 February 2021, paragraph (a) of subsection (1) shall have effect as if there were substituted “21 per cent” for “23 per cent”. — Standard rate 23%; temporarily 21% from 1 Sep 2020 to 28 Feb 2021, so 23% again from 1 Mar 2021.
source_title: Law Reform Commission Revised Acts: Value-Added Tax Consolidation Act 2010, section 46 (revised, with annotations); cross-checked with Revenue 'Current VAT rates' table (https://www.revenue.ie/en/vat/vat-rates/search-vat-rates/current-vat-rates.aspx) listing 1 March 2021 – 23%

reduced_rates.scope: Schedule 3 goods/services: e.g. fuel for power and heating (other than those at 9%), building and construction services, short-term guest accommodation, certain repair and maintenance, tourist attraction admissions

newspapers/periodicals and e-publications, sporting facilities; gas and electricity until 31 Dec 2030; certain apartment construction (social policy) until 31 Dec 2030; from 1 Jul 2026 food and drink in restaurant/catering/hot takeaway services (excl. alcohol, soft drinks, bottled water) and hairdressing (Finance Act 2025 s. 71)
Schedule 2: most food, oral medicines, children's clothing and footwear, books (printed), exports, intra-EU supplies

notes: Flat-rate addition for unregistered farmers 4.5% from 1 January 2026 (Revenue table). Several 9% measures are time-limited to 31 December 2030 (gas/electricity, social-policy apartments) and would revert to 13.5% thereafter unless extended. Standard 23% first applied from 1 January 2012 (Finance Act 2012 s. 87); temporarily 21% 1.9.2020–28.2.2021. TEDB (situation 2026-07-01) shows 23%, 13.5%, 9%, 0% — consistent.
